newsitem.title: USA: Maine University seeks 3 pct rise in state funds.
newsitem.headline: Maine University seeks 3 pct rise in state funds.

text.p: NEW YORK, Jan 20 (Reuter) University of Maine officials asked for a three-percent boost in state money over the next two years, but Gov Angus King seeks a slightly different schedule of increases.
The governor wants a one-percent increase next year and a two-percent increase next year.

University Chancellor Terrence MacTaggart said the students will have to pay the difference if state funding doesn't keep pace with inflation. The average tuition at the seven campuses has shot up 71-percent since 1990.
